notes: Lightweight aggregator/marketplace listings for indie AI products. Fees and featured prices change often — verify on each site before selling.

markets.name: Gumroad
markets.fee_note: 10% + $0.50 per direct/profile sale; 30% flat via Discover marketplace (processing included on Discover).

markets.name: PromptBase
markets.fee_note: 0% via your referral/seller link; 20% via marketplace listings.

markets.name: There's An AI For That
markets.fee_note: Browse free; paid/featured listing options for visibility (check current submit/pricing page).

markets.name: Futurepedia
markets.focus: AI tools directory with categories and filters
markets.fee_note: Free browsing; listing/featured plans for tool makers (verify current submit terms).

markets.name: Product Hunt
markets.fee_note: Free to launch; Ship / ads / featured options are paid (see Product Hunt for makers).

markets.name: AlternativeTo (AI)
markets.fee_note: Community listings free; Premium/ads for promoted placement.

markets.name: AI Tools Directory style hubs
markets.focus: Generic AI tool aggregation / SEO discovery
markets.fee_note: Often free submit + paid featured slots; terms vary by site.

markets.name: Toolify.ai
markets.focus: AI tools ranking and traffic estimates
markets.fee_note: Free listing options plus paid promotion packages (verify current pricing).

markets.name: Lemon Squeezy
markets.focus: Digital products & SaaS payments (Merchant of Record)
markets.fee_note: 5% + $0.50 per transaction (no monthly ecommerce fee); some payments may incur additional fees.

markets.name: itch.io
markets.fee_note: Seller-set revenue share (default open; you choose cut). Payment processor fees still apply.
